gaps.explanation: Schedule is 55,613 above the statement. Detail revenue lines 0-7 come from the p8 Supplementary Budgetary Comparison Schedule for ALL FUNDS COMBINED (Total Revenues and Transfers 195,720), tagged governmental, but it combines the governmental funds with the utility fund: its 'Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts' 98,393 holds the governmental other receipts (p4: Interest 3,878 + Dividend 758 + Electrical Distribution System Lease 32,698 + Charges For Services 1,340 + Claims 279 + Licenses 3,213 = 42,166) and the utility fund's cash receipts (98,393 - 42,166 = 56,227 = p7 53,138 + 150 + 2,939); its Sales Tax 22,011 vs p4 22,625. The 98,393 line cannot be split by fund from the page. Per the user's per-fund detail ruling (2026-10-27, villages: a combined all-funds schedule is replaced by one line per fund column of the governmental and proprietary funds statements) and as done for Hubbard_FY2022, remove the p8 lines 0-7 (sum 195,720; their money is held by the per-fund lines added here and in the business-type revenue entry, so they would count it twice) and add the printed rows of the General Fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4; 13 rows = General Fund Total Revenues 140,097) plus the Fire Department Fund Interest Income 10 from the Other Governmental Funds combining schedule (p10; the statement's Other Governmental Funds column prints the same 10; Municipal Infrastructure Revenue Fund prints nothing). Check: 195,720 - 195,720 + 140,097 + 10 = 140,107 = p4 Total Revenues. Governmental expenditures stay from the p9 combining schedule (146,996, ties). The p8 budget column is lost with the removed lines.
